result.description:
Job title:  Physiotherapist 

  Job type:  Full time or part time 

  Salary offer:  Competitive salary offer + benefits 

  Location:  Joondalup or Ellenbrook clinics 

   

  About the company:  

 Our client is a well-established, private multidisciplinary allied health practice that has been proudly supporting children and adolescents through family-centered, evidence-based therapy since 1994. With purpose-built clinics in Joondalup and Ellenbrook, they are a trusted provider across Perth’s northern suburbs. 

 Their dedicated team includes professionals in  Physiotherapy, Speech Pathology, Occupational Therapy, Psychology , and  Dietetics , as well as a specialised  Autism Diagnostic Clinic . They foster a culture of collaboration, connection, and commitment to making a meaningful difference in the lives of the families they support. 

   

  About the role:  

 We are currently seeking a passionate  Physiotherapist  to join this dynamic and supportive multidisciplinary team. This is an exciting opportunity to provide holistic, client-focused care to children and adolescents in a warm and collaborative clinical environment. 

 In this role, you will provide  assessment and intervention  for clients experiencing a range of physical and developmental challenges, including: 

 
	 Gross motor development delays 
	 Developmental coordination disorders 
	 Neurological and musculoskeletal conditions 
	 Postural and movement difficulties 
	 Support for children with disabilities and complex needs 
 

 You will collaborate closely with other allied health professionals to design and deliver integrated care plans that support each child’s individual goals. 

   

  What's in it for you?  

 
	 Work within a collaborative, multidisciplinary team 
	 Established client base and structured referral pathways 
	 Ongoing professional development and clinical supervision 
	 Purpose-built clinics with state-of-the-art resources 
	 Opportunities for clinical specialisation and career progression 
	 Supportive and inclusive workplace culture 
 

   

  Requirements:  

 
	 Tertiary qualifications in Physiotherapy 
	   Apply Now
result.title: Physiotherapist – Join a Collaborative Allied Health Practice | Perth

result.description:
An excellent opportunity has become available for a  General Practitioner  and a  Medical Director  to join an established and expanding practice in the picturesque town of  Katoomba, NSW . Situated in the heart of the World Heritage-listed Blue Mountains, this location offers a fantastic  lifestyle  with a strong community feel, all within a 90-minute drive of the Sydney CBD. 

 The practice recently moved into a new, purpose-built health hub, significantly expanding its capacity to serve a large and diverse patient base. The modern facility includes 16 consultation rooms, 3 dedicated skin rooms, 2 procedure rooms, and a 4-bed treatment room. The centre also has onsite pathology and allied health services, ensuring comprehensive patient care. This  mixed-billing  centre operates Monday to Friday, providing doctors with a great  work-life balance  and a high earning potential. 

 You will have  clinical autonomy  and the benefit of  flexible working arrangements . The dedicated team of experienced nurses and administrative staff, many of whom have worked in the area for up to 25 years, provide outstanding support to help you build your practice quickly. The practice offers a broad scope of practice with a wide variety of case presentations, allowing you to care for patients of all ages and build long-term relationships that provide continuity of care. The practice is also a  DPA-approved location , and there are opportunities for both permanent and locum positions. For those interested in professional development, the practice supports a range of  special interests  including skin, aesthetics, and occupational medicine.   Apply Now

result.description: Kakadu Tourism  We're on the look-out for a capable Accounts Clerk (Finance Officer) to join our team at Cooinda Lodge Kakadu, in the heart of Kakadu National Park.  If you thrive in a dynamic hotel/tourism environment, take pride in supporting the financial function, and want to live and work in one of Australia's most iconic natural settings - this could be the role for you.   Benefits   Competitive Salary Package $68,000 - $78,000   Full time and ongoing position  Work in one of Australia’s most iconic tourism destinations  Career development and progression opportunities  Employee discounts on tours and accommodation worldwide  Supportive and inclusive team culture       Task & responsibilities  C   Qualification & experience   Relevant tertiary qualification in Finance, Business or related discipline  2 years' previous experience as an Accounts Clerk or related position  Sound knowledge and understanding of financial and accounting procedures, policies and systems  Advanced computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and financial software   About Company    Nestled in the heart of Kakadu National Park, Cooinda Lodge Kakadu is more than just a destination—it’s an experience. Surrounded by breathtaking landscapes, ancient Indigenous culture, and rich biodiversity, our lodge serves as a gateway to one of Australia's most iconic and sacred places.   Our Mission   At Cooinda Lodge Kakadu, our mission is to deliver exceptional hospitality experiences that connect guests with the beauty, culture, and spirit of Kakadu National Park. We strive to create unforgettable moments, ensuring every visitor leaves with a deep appreciation for this unique landscape and its people.   Our Values   We are guided by a commitment to:   Authenticity – Honouring the rich cultural heritage of the land and its Traditional Owners.  Excellence – Delivering high-quality service and unforgettable experiences.  Sustainability – Protecting our environment and promoting responsible tourism.  Inclusivity – Fostering a diverse, welcoming workplace where everyone is valued.  Community Engagement – Supporting and collaborating with Indigenous communities.    An Inclusive and Supportive Work Culture   At Cooinda Lodge Kakadu, we celebrate diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered. Our team is made up of individuals from different backgrounds and cultures, all united by a shared passion for hospitality, nature, and Indigenous heritage.  We are committed to:   Equal opportunities for career growth and development.  Cultural appreciation and learning, including working closely with the local Indigenous community.   A supportive and team-oriented environment, where collaboration and respect are at the core of everything we do.    Our Achievements   Cooinda Lodge Kakadu is proud of its continued recognition as a premier eco-tourism destination. Some of our key accomplishments include:   Award-winning Indigenous tourism experiences, such as our Yellow Water Cruises, led by local guides sharing their deep knowledge of the land and its stories.  Sustainable tourism initiatives, including water conservation, energy-efficient operations, and eco-friendly accommodation practices.  Strong partnerships with Indigenous communities, ensuring authentic cultural representation and meaningful employment opportunities.  Consistently high guest satisfaction for our exceptional service, accommodation, and unique cultural experiences.    Join Our Team   When you work at Cooinda Lodge Kakadu, you become part of something special—a team dedicated to delivering inspiring experiences, protecting the environment, and celebrating Indigenous culture. Whether you're serving guests, guiding tours, or supporting lodge operations, your role contributes to a truly meaningful mission.
